mahsuri.style: Young Malay woman with a slight Malaysian accent. Quiet and haunted.

sectionStyles.prologue: Young Malay woman, frightened and confused, voice trembling and quiet, close to tears. Slight Malaysian accent.
sectionStyles.deadStare: Young Malay woman, frightened and confused, voice trembling and quiet. Slight Malaysian accent.
sectionStyles.reveal: Young Malay woman, calm, sorrowful and dignified, speaking slowly with quiet strength, like a final vow. Slight Malaysian accent.
sectionStyles.curse: Young Malay woman remembering something terrible, slow, sorrowful and haunting, almost a whisper. Slight Malaysian accent.
sectionStyles.curseEnd: Young Malay woman, quiet realisation, sorrowful but calm. Slight Malaysian accent.
sectionStyles.dawn: Young Malay woman, peaceful and relieved at last, soft and gentle, almost smiling. Slight Malaysian accent.

mahsuri.fallbackStyle: Speak slowly and quietly, sad and reflective, like telling an old story. Slight Malaysian accent.

woman.style: Speak in a sweet, teasing voice with a hint of coldness, like a sly older woman toying with someone. Clear and confident, at a normal speaking volume, NOT whispering. Slight Malaysian accent.
woman.fallbackStyle: Speak slowly and softly in a sweet, teasing voice with a hint of coldness, like a sly older woman. Slight Malaysian accent.

chief.style: Very deep, old Malay village elder. Cold and stern, like passing a death sentence. Low and gravelly, slight Malaysian accent.
chief.fallbackStyle: Deep, slow, stern older man's voice. Slight Malaysian accent.

narrator.style: Soft, hushed storyteller, like recalling a half-forgotten memory. Slow and haunting, almost a whisper. Slight Malaysian accent.
narrator.fallbackStyle: Soft, slow storyteller voice. Slight Malaysian accent.

lineStyles.board_wan_lose_01: Older woman SHOUTING in shock and fury, loud and sharp, outraged that she has lost. The sweetness is completely gone. Slight Malaysian accent.
lineStyles.board_wan_lose_02: Older woman, still furious, loud and bitter, spitting the words. Slight Malaysian accent.
lineStyles.board_wan_lose_03: Older woman, furious and sarcastic, loud and sharp. Slight Malaysian accent.
lineStyles.board_wan_lose_04: Older woman, angry and contemptuous, voice raised, sneering. Slight Malaysian accent.
lineStyles.board_wan_lose_final: Older woman, cold fury, low and threatening, every word slow and deliberate. Slight Malaysian accent.
